title: Acting in Haste Comes at a High Cost
fullPassage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
